reason: The first order is cash on delivery, so I lose nothing by trying one small batch of phone accessories to see if it really comes and if I can resell it with profit. I would not do more than that one order until I see the goods in my hand.
objection: After the first order they want the item money up front by Zain Cash or Qi, and that is exactly how people lose money to pages. Also 21,000 on a 30,000 item eats my resale margin, and if the driver can't find my street I don't know what happens.
would_change_my_mind: Keep cash on delivery for every order, not only the first one; then I would order every week for the shop.
